snippet.title: Medal of Honor: Underground | GBA | 2000/2002 | Video Game US Trailer | LQ/OGR
snippet.description:
US Trailer for the Game Boy Advance version of the Medal of Honor: Underground video game.

Original version of the game published in United States by EA under the EA Games brand in 2000 for PlayStation
Published in United States by Destination Software in 2002 for Game Boy Advance
Original version of the game developed by DreamWorks Interactive
Game Boy Advance version ported by Rebellion Developments

Trailer in low quality. Original resolution.
